title: Lion cub dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M72 62 Q86 52 80 66 Q78 70 84 68" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="67" r="4" fill="#e8801a"/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="80" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="86" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#e8801a"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="82" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="88" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#e8801a"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="66" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#fbc02d"/>
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="70" rx="13" ry="10" fill="#ffe082"/>
  <!-- front legs raised in dance -->
  <path d="M40 58 Q28 48 24 40" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="23" cy="38" r="5" fill="#e8801a"/>
  <path d="M68 58 Q80 50 84 42" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="40" r="5" fill="#e8801a"/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx="54" cy="34" r="24" fill="#e8801a"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="34" r="24" fill="none" stroke="#ff9800" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="3 4"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="54" cy="34" r="17" fill="#fbc02d"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="20" r="6" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="20" r="3" fill="#ffcc80"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="20" r="6" fill="#f5a623"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="20" r="3" fill="#ffcc80"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="40" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#ffe082"/>
  <!-- eyes happy -->
  <path d="M45 31 Q48 27 51 31" stroke="#6d4c00" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M57 31 Q60 27 63 31" stroke="#6d4c00" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d="M51 37 L57 37 L54 41 Z" fill="#a0522d"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M48 43 Q54 48 60 43" stroke="#6d4c00" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1="42" y1="39" x2="34" y2="37" stroke="#c07000" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="42" x2="34" y2="43" stroke="#c07000" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="39" x2="74" y2="37" stroke="#c07000" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="66" y1="42" x2="74" y2="43" stroke="#c07000" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- dance sparkles -->
  <path d="M20 22 L22 26 L26 24 L23 27 L26 30 L22 28 L20 32 L19 28 L15 30 L18 27 L15 24 L19 26 Z" fill="#fff59d"/>
  <path d="M84 22 L86 26 L90 24 L87 27 L90 30 L86 28 L84 32 L83 28 L79 30 L82 27 L79 24 L83 26 Z" fill="#fff59d"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="16" r="2" fill="#fff59d"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="16" r="2" fill="#fff59d"/>
  <!-- motion lines -->
  <path d="M18 52 Q22 50 26 52" stroke="#ffb74d" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M16 58 Q20 56 24 58" stroke="#ffb74d" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M80 56 Q84 54 88 56" stroke="#ffb74d" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
